author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Subnautica 2 is already a hit in Early Access, selling 2 million copies in one day. This comes despite some crazy legal trouble with their parent company KRAFTON (which you should look up because it's kind of nuts), and some players finding the multiplayer offerings a little lacking. In other news, LEGO 2K Drive is being delisted after only being available for three years. The fun little racing game earned solid reviews, and publisher 2K games has not revealed why it's being removed from digital storefronts. Multiplayer will continue to work until sometime next year. And finally, the former director of Star Wars: The Old Republic spilled some tea on a cancelled reboot of the game, which originally would have been set in the New Republic era of Star Wars.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Subnautica 2 Makes a Huge Splash with 2 Million Copies Sold in a Day - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Subnautica 2 has officially arrived in Early Access, bringing one of the community’s most requested features to the alien depths: full online multiplayer. Whether you're looking to dive into the bioluminescent waters of a new planet with a veteran crew or just want a hand gathering resources, we’ve got you covered. This guide breaks down exactly how to host a session, how to convert your existing single-player saves into co-op worlds, and the specific steps required to get crossplay working between different platforms. 

Mastering the Subnautica 2 co-op experience is essential for survival in this massive open-world underwater sequel. From generating 8-digit invite codes for cross-platform play to understanding how shared Scanner Stations and respawn bio pods affect your team's efficiency, knowing these mechanics will keep your squad from drowning in the details. As Unknown Worlds expands the game through its Early Access roadmap, we’ll continue to provide the latest tips on resource
title: Subnautica 2 Multiplayer Guide: How to Play With Friends

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Season 3 Teaser Trailer for The Walking Dead: Dead City, the hit zombie action spin-off series in The Walking Dead universe distributed by AMC. Legacy characters fight for a thriving community in Manhattan in Season 3 of The Walking Dead: Dead City, streaming on AMC and AMC+ on July 26.

Maggie and Negan finally put aside their differences to build the first thriving community in Manhattan since the apocalypse, but when chaos in the city begins to arise, they are forced to question: have they learned from their old wounds or will their dark past spell doom for the entire city?  

Season 3 of The Walking Dead: Dead City stars Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Lauren Cohan, Jimmi Simpson, Raúl Castillo, Aimee Garcia, Logan Kim, Michael Emery, and more. The series is executive produced by Scott M. Gimple and showran by Seth Hoffman, Cohan, Morgan, Brian Bockrath, and Colin Walsh.

Season 3 of The Walking Dead: Dead City is streaming on AMC and AMC+ on July 26.
title: The Walking Dead: Dead City Season 3 - Official Teaser Trailer (2026)

description:
Take a look at the Gameplay Deep Dive Trailer for EA Sports UFC 6, the latest addition to the mixed martial arts simulation game developed by EA. Players can get the rundown on the key improvements and features coming with UFC 6, including the implementation of Markerless Capture and Sapien Technology that offers more true-to-life strikes, movements, attacks, and more. Real-Time Contact, powered by Frostbite, brings heightened ragdoll physics and damage reactions, alongside Flow State that focuses the fighter's gameplay to finish the fight. EA Sports UFC 6 is launching on June 19 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.

#UFC6 #Gaming #IGN
title: EA Sports UFC 6 - Official Gameplay Deep Dive Video
